items.title: Elorian AI's Glimpse now available on AI Gateway
items.summary: is now available on AI Gateway. The visual reasoning model accepts images and video to follow objects through motion, interpret spatial relationships, and connect an action to its physical consequences.Glimpse from ElorianGlimpse can return to visual evidence as it works: zooming into a detail, revisiting a short interval of video, or tracking the same feature across frames. This allows the model to support use cases like scientific chart analysis, video captioning, visual counting, and robotics data annotation.Some examples include checking a train's motion to determine whether it is slowing down, keeping objects distinct through camera movement, and labeling completed actions in robot footage.Use  as the model name:elorian/glimpseWith AI SDK 7, you can send a video as a file part.
